Holdout Juror Speaks on Mistrial in Mother's Murder Case

A holdout juror in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who was accused of murdering her three young children, has broken his silence following a mistrial. The juror stated he had no doubt that Clancy deliberately killed her children. He was the sole juror who refused to acquit Clancy, leading the judge to declare a mistrial. The juror's attorney has indicated he will not be giving further interviews.
